svg.title: Ember and Iron — one goal, three places
svg.desc: One Next goal guides the player through Mine, Forge and Shop. Each tab has a focused scene. Manage holds the deeper RPG systems, and the adventure theatre is optional.

text.tspan: EMBER & IRON · v0.5
Know your next step. Enjoy the place.
One focused workspace, with the full blacksmith RPG a step away.
NEXT GOAL
Forge your first Bronze Shortsword
Your materials are ready. Make one useful piece for the shop.
GO TO FORGE →
1 MINE
Gather the materials you need.
Develop the supply you depend on.
2 FORGE
Choose one available recipe.
Make it, improve it, practice it.
3 SHOP
Fill the shelves; see the outcome.
Customers handle their own lives.
MANAGE · OPEN WHEN YOU NEED IT
Upgrades Smith Journal Legacy
Stations, staff, stats, mastery, collection, customer history and permanent talents remain available.
Their depth stays intact without becoming a row of competing tasks on the workbench.
ADVENTURE THEATRE · OPTIONAL
Open a watch-only panel when you want to follow a customer.
Their gear drives the actual battle. NPCs buy, form parties, travel, recover and retry themselves.
Close the theatre at any time; the world keeps moving while you mine, forge or arrange the shop.
ART THAT MAKES THE WORK READABLE
Original 16-bit landscapes, large expressive characters, strong outlines and bright shading.
Forge, Shop and Mine have distinct close-ups at a native 640 × 240 aspect.
Activity follows real crafts, displayed stock and customer events. No invented purchases or rewards.
Labeled controls and reduced motion keep the same information accessible.
Sixty recipes · twelve proficiencies · six regions · twenty-four Legacy talents · unchanged gameplay rules
